# PokéCards-Collector

> A free Pokémon Trading Card Game catalogue and collection tracker. Every English, Japanese and French card, each with its
> Cardmarket price in euros, plus collection tracking, wishlists, a binder builder and two daily card games.

The catalogue is refreshed from [TCGdex](https://api.tcgdex.net) every day. Prices are Cardmarket values in EUR,
covering both the standard and the reverse-holo print of a card. Browsing needs no account; tracking a collection,
a wishlist or a binder needs a free one.

A card page has a readable URL made of the card name, its set and its number, for example `/card/charizard-base-set-4`.
English cards live at `/card/<slug>`, Japanese cards at `/jp-card/<slug>` (the slug keeps the Japanese name and uses the set id, as in
`/jp-card/リザードンex-sv2a-201`) and French cards at `/fr-card/<slug>`. Behind the URL, each card has an internal code of the form
`supertype_pokemonId_setCode_cardNumber`, for example `pokemon_6_base1_4`; the old `/card/<code>` URLs redirect to the slug.

## Browse

- [All cards](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/cards-list): every English card, filterable by set, artist, rarity, type and Pokémon, sortable by price, name or Pokédex number. Filters are URL parameters: `?set=`, `?artist=`, `?rarity=`, `?type=`, `?pokemon=` (Pokédex number), `?name=`, `?sortby=`, `?sortorder=`.
- [Sets](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/sets): every set with its release date, card count and the estimated euro value of a complete set. Each set has its own page at `/sets/<set name slug>` (for example `/sets/30th-celebration`), with its release date, series, total value, most valuable cards and a checklist of every card with its number and price. French sets live at `/france/sets/<slug>` and Japanese sets at `/japan/sets/<slug>`.
- [Pokémon](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/pokemons): all 1025 Pokémon and the cards depicting them.
- [Artists](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/artists): the illustrators behind the cards, with their full card list.
- [Japanese cards](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/japan): the Japanese catalogue, with its own sets and prices.
- [French cards](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/france): the French catalogue, with its own sets and prices. A card with no French scan shows the English one.

## Collect

- [Collectors](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/users): public collections, ranked by unique cards owned.
- [Binder builder](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/binder): lay out a digital binder page and export it as an image.

## Play

- [Card.dle](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/card.dle): guess the mystery card of the day; the same card for every player, seeded from the date.
- [Guess the Price](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/guess-the-price): estimate what a real card is worth on Cardmarket.

## Optional

- [Sitemap index](https://pokecards-collector.ayfri.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL, split into a pages sitemap and chunked card sitemaps.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Ayfri/PokeCards-Collector): SvelteKit 3 + Svelte 5 on Cloudflare Workers, data in Supabase Postgres.
